## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Use Case

## Additional Context

---

## Before You Submit

**Network-dependent features cannot be accepted.** About Face has no network entitlement by design. This means the following cannot be implemented:

- Analytics or telemetry
- Appearance description ("what do I look like", "is my hair OK")
- Model downloads or in-app updates
- Third-party integrations that require network access

If your feature request involves network access, please open a discussion instead to talk about the design constraints.
